desc:
🌀 CLIMB. THROW. TROLL. 🎯

Welcome to Boomerang Tower — the ultimate Troll Tower experience!

Use your boomerang, slaps, and other crazy weapons to knock players off as you race to the top of a giant stud tower!
Outsmart your enemies, troll your friends, and send everyone flying back to the bottom. 😈😂

There's nothing better than hearing kids cry in voice chat after getting launched mid-jump. 😂
